critical.name: RDS
critical.description: MongoDB connection string for Remote Data Store

critical.name: PLDYNID
critical.description: Discord Guild ID for Planetary Dynamics server

required.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
required.description: Anthropic API key for Claude AI features

required.name: MEDIALOG
required.description: Channel ID for media player logging

required.name: ENGINEERING
required.description: Channel ID for engineering deck logs

required.name: SIMLAB
required.description: Channel ID for simulation lab (Claude standard tier)

required.name: DEVLAB
required.description: Channel ID for dev lab (Claude with extended thinking)

amp.description: CubeCoders AMP game server control integration

vars.name: AMP_USERNAME
vars.description: AMP API user with instance start/stop permissions

vars.name: AMP_PASSWORD
vars.description: Password for the AMP API user

optional.name: JWST
optional.description: James Webb Space Telescope API key

optional.name: API_AUTH_TOKEN
optional.description: API authorization token (auto-generated if not set)

optional.name: ADMIN_USER_IDS
optional.description: Comma-separated Discord user IDs allowed to run admin-only slash commands (/ytdlp-update, /amp start|stop etc.). Falls back to guild Administrator permission when unset.

optional.name: JELLYFIN_PATH_MAP
optional.description: Optional comma-separated prefix map (from=>to) translating Jellyfin Item.Path values to container-visible paths. Example: /media/music=>/mnt/nas/music,/media/abk=>/mnt/nas/abk

optional.name: AMP_AUDIT_CHANNEL
optional.description: Channel ID for the AMP control-action audit trail. Falls back to ENGINEERING when unset.

optional.name: AMP_ALERT_CHANNEL
optional.description: Channel ID for AMP game server crash alerts. Falls back to ENGINEERING when unset.

optional.name: BESZEL_ALERT_CHANNEL
optional.description: Channel ID for Beszel system state-change alerts. Falls back to ENGINEERING when unset.

optional.name: COMPUTER_CMD_COOLDOWN_SEC
optional.description: Per-user cooldown (seconds) between /computer slash command invocations.
